thread:
Ethan (Sales): Heads-up: Meridian Clinics signed pilot for private deployment + FHIR connector. 6-week pilot, possible enterprise roll in Q3. Need CS + eng handoff today.

Zoe (CSM): Congrats! Can you paste the SOW + any technical asks? I'll book kickoff and own success plan.

Ethan (Sales): SOW link: https://drive.redwood.example/meridian/sow_v2 (redacted). Tech asks: FHIR v4 ingestion, data residency EU-only, patient-id hashing, and nightly export to their analytics S3. Procurement noted their renewal decision window is tight (45 days before pilot end).

Aaron (Solutions Eng): FHIR+EU residency means private deploy in their VPC w/ egress controls. Do we have an approved hashing pattern? Any PII minimization reqs?

Nico (Platform Eng): We can wire VPC peering + egress ACLs. For EU-only storage we'll need to pin storage region and disable cross-region failover for this tenant. I'll own infra tasks.

Zoe (CSM): Owners: Zoe = overall CS owner & enablement; Aaron = FHIR connector + ingestion tests; Nico = infra/VPC/storage controls; Mei = support runbook & pilot triage. Ethan to keep customer contacts.

Ethan (Sales): Contact list added to SOW link (ops@meridian.health, secops@meridian.health). They also asked for a data retention policy doc and a short SLA for pilot.

Mei (Support): I'll draft a pilot SLA (non-binding) and a runbook. Need expected error classes and how to simulate degraded network for failover tests.

Aaron (Solutions Eng): Known failure modes: 1) FHIR search timeouts under patient-batch >500, 2) schema variance on resource extensions, 3) nightly export failing due to perms. Observability: include request id + fhir_resource + tenant_id in traces.

Zoe (CSM): Pilot plan (high-level): Week 0: internal kickoff + ticket creation. Week 1: infra ready + FHIR dev ingest with synthetic data. Week 2: validation + analytics export. Week 3-4: pilot usage + collect feedback. Week 5: adoption review + renewal prep.

Ethan (Sales): Renewal note: customer procurement needs final contract signed 45 days before pilot end; flagging as medium risk if pilot delays slip beyond week 4.

infra-bot: Created ticket CS-6019 (Meridian private infra / EU region) assigned to Nico. Created ticket SE-7710 (FHIR connector smoke tests) assigned to Aaron.

Nico (Platform Eng): ETA: spinning staging PEER and storage bucket by +48h. Will add IAM least-privilege template to ticket.

Aaron (Solutions Eng): Quick curl to smoke FHIR ingest (dev):
```
curl -X POST https://private.redwood/tenant/meridian/fhir/Patient \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEV_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/fhir+json" \
  -d '{"resourceType":"Patient","id":"p-test-001","identifier":[{"system":"urn:meridian","value":"hashed-id"}]}'
```
Note: ensure we use hashed patient id, not raw PHI.

Mei (Support): Adding pilot incident actions: rotate hashing key, backfill missing exports, force re-ingest idempotent endpoint, and notification template for customer ops. Will link runbook.

Zoe (CSM): Feedback capture: I'm setting up a short survey (Typeform) + weekly quick check calls. Metrics we need in console: token usage, FHIR ingest success rate, export success rate, avg latency p95. Add adoption goal: >=60% ingest coverage and <=1% export failures.

Ethan (Sales): Legal asked for GDPR addendum + DPA sign-off. Zoe please loop Security/Legal asap.

Nico (Platform Eng): Noted. I'll include encryption-at-rest in EU region and ensure keys are in their KMS per DPA.

Aaron (Solutions Eng): Risk register quick: 1) Region pinning delays (mitigation: prioritize infra ticket), 2) Schema mismatches (mitigation: sample data early), 3) Procurement timing (mitigation: weekly renewal check-ins with Ethan).

Mei (Support): I'll prepare a triage rotation and add contact matrix to CS-6019.

Zoe (CSM): Action items (confirming):
- Ethan: upload final SOW + customer contacts (due: today)
- Nico: staging VPC peering + EU storage bucket + IAM template (due: +2 days)
- Aaron: FHIR connector dev ingest + smoke tests + test data sample (due: +3 days)
- Mei: support runbook + incident playbook + rotation (due: +3 days)
- Zoe: kickoff invite + pilot success plan + Typeform (due: +1 day)

Ethan (Sales): SOW link updated with contacts. Sent calendar invite to ops@meridian.health for kickoff.

Aaron (Solutions Eng): SE-7710 updated: sample payloads uploaded, initial schema issues flagged.

Nico (Platform Eng): CS-6019 updated with bucket ARN, peering request sent to Meridian.

Mei (Support): Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.example/runbooks/meridian-pilot (stubbed). Survey link: https://forms.redwood.example/meridian-pilot-feedback.

Zoe (CSM): Last note: kickoff 9am CET tomorrow. If any blocker emerges, post here and tag :rotating_light:. Thanks everyone.
